description: This file defines the Currency entity class for the sales management system. It maps to the CURRENCY table in the database and includes properties such as currency code, name, support status, and the actual java.util.Currency object.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Entity class representing a currency with mapping to the database and business logic for handling currency properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the currency entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the currency entity.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the java.util.Currency object associated with this entity.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the java.util.Currency object and updates the code accordingly.

methods.name: getSupported
methods.description: Returns whether the currency is supported.

methods.name: setSupported
methods.description: Sets the supported status of the currency.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code, ensuring it reflects the currency's current code.

methods.name: getSymbol
methods.description: Returns the symbol associated with this currency.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currency.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the currency.
